title: Free-free beam, modal
sentence: The same rectangular-section cantilever as cantilever-modal, this time with no constraints at all — six zero-frequency rigid-body modes, then the beam's own bending frequencies.
theory: A free body has six rigid-body modes — three translations, three rotations — that cost no elastic energy and so sit at zero frequency to within the eigen solver's own tolerance, never at a clean, repeated zero. `procedure: "modal"` is one of only two Steps (`explicit` is the other) that skips the rigid-mode well-posedness check a `static` Step enforces, because an unconstrained body is a legitimate model, not a mistake. The first real mode bends the beam: for a free-free prismatic beam $f_n = \frac{\beta_n^2}{2\pi}\sqrt{EI/(\rho A L^4)}$ with $\beta_1 = 4.730041$, a different constant from the clamped-free beam's $1.8751$ because the boundary conditions differ, not the formula.
